North Delta condos for sale: apartment-style homes in strata buildings. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for apartments (condos) in North Delta was $479,000 in September 2026 (-11.6% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
North Delta condos sold, November 2025 to October 2026

42 condos sold in North Delta with a median price of $488,000 (the middle half sold between $406,000 and $575,750), taking a median of 38 days to sell at 96.0% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $605 per square foot, a median year built of 2017 and a median strata fee of $431 a month.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: streets and boundaries

items.t: Condo stock follows two corridors: Scott Road (120 Street) from 72 Avenue to Nordel Way, and 84 Avenue through the Nordel Social Heart.

The Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw No. 8400, 2024, plans most growth in the Scott Road Corridor: about 14,000 people in about 6,100 new households, North Delta reaching an estimated 87,000 people by 2051.
Scott Road is the municipal boundary — its east side is Surrey, which is why the Scottsdale Exchange hub serving North Delta addresses sits in Surrey.
Delta-wide zoning follows Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, 2017.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: the housing stock

items.t: Delta Rise, 11967 80 Avenue, is North Delta's only high-rise condo tower: 38 storeys, built 2017, at Scott Road and 80 Avenue.
Chancellor Place, 11910 and 11920 80 Avenue, is one complex in two concrete towers, built 1989/1990 — one strata question, not two buildings.
Delta Cedars, 8635 120 Street, is the corridor's oldest stock: built 1972/1973, 96 units, outdoor pool and shared laundry.

Muse North Delta, 9015 120 Street, mixes apartment and townhouse units under one strata and one address; The Residences at Sunstone Village, 8360 Delsom Way, are the Nordel-side apartments (54 condominiums at launch).
Scott & Nicholson, 6950 and 6960 Nicholson Road, is a two-building apartment development of 188 units, approved under Bylaws 7818 and 7819 in 2019.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: rules that affect buyers

items.t: New Scott Road buildings are judged in the Scott Road Corridor (SRC) Development Permit Area: form and character are regulated by development permit under OCP Bylaw No. 8400, 2024.
The earlier North Delta area plan does not carry into Bylaw No. 8400 (2024); Development Permit Areas sit in Appendix B.
Long-term rental-restriction bylaws are unenforceable since November 24, 2022 (Delta Cedars is the local directory example); the only enforceable age bylaw is 55-plus (55+).

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The R6 deliberately skips Scottsdale Exchange; TransLink states riders connect to local routes at shared on-street stops on Scott Road and 72 Avenue instead.
A lake once sat under the Scott & Nicholson site: the City's 2019 hearing record notes Scott Lake used to flow through the Nicholson Road area — hence its stormwater conditions.
Arland Mews Co-operative, 11865 80 Avenue, sits in the same Scottsdale blocks as the towers but is a housing co-operative — membership and occupancy, not strata ownership.
Sunstone's 55-plus building, 10775 Delsom Crescent, is a 70-unit rental block beside the strata Residences — its age rule is a tenancy rule, not a strata bylaw.
The R6 was a $33 million joint TransLink, Surrey and Delta investment with a dedicated busway near 72 Avenue; TransLink calls Scott Road the busiest corridor south of the Fraser River.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: development and new projects

items.t: Rezoning to Apartment Residential 6 (RA6), SRC Development Permit Area permit, rear-setback variance 7.5 m to 5 m; the City states the proposal fits the SRC designation in OCP Bylaw No. 8400, 2024. Status: second public information meeting February 4, 2026; not yet before Council at the January 22, 2026 notice (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: costs and taxes

items.t: 37 (Delta) is $1.0997 per $1,000 of residential value, set by provincial order — the same rate lands on a North Delta condo's notice as on a Tsawwassen house's.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: getting around

items.t: The R6 is North Delta's spine: Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange, 13 stops, with North Delta stops at Nordel Way, 84 Avenue, 80 Avenue, 75A Avenue and 72 Avenue.
Scott Road Station, at the corridor's north end, is the Expo Line SkyTrain connection; the R6 exists because no SkyTrain line runs down Scott Road itself.
The OCP's growth plan is built around this corridor and the provincially designated Transit-Oriented Area around Scottsdale Exchange, across Scott Road in Surrey.

blocks.text: North Delta Condos: risks and due diligence

items.t: Age splits the risk: Delta Cedars (1972/1973) and Chancellor Place (1989/1990) are inside the mandatory depreciation-report cycle on roof, piping and parkade years the 2017–2023 buildings have not reached — compare contingency reserve fund balances, not headline fees.
Check the Form B for approved special levies still payable and the insurance summary; its water-damage deductible is the figure a unit-owner policy is usually matched against.
Scott Road frontage is a construction corridor: with about 6,100 new households planned along it, check a corridor-facing unit against the Scott Road Height Map in OCP Bylaw No. 8400.
